description: This file defines the IPlacementDirector interface within the Orleans.Runtime.Placement namespace, including a constant for placement hint key, a method for selecting a silo for activation, and a static method for retrieving placement hints from request context data.

classes.name: IPlacementDirector
classes.description: Interface for placement directors responsible for selecting appropriate silos for grain activation and retrieving placement hints.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Asynchronously selects an appropriate silo address for placing a grain based on the provided placement strategy, target, and context.

methods.name: GetPlacementHint
methods.description: Static method that retrieves a placement hint (silo address) from request context data if present and valid.
